verdict.rationale: Better Auth's docs show it is self-hosted with your own database (SQLite/Postgres/MySQL) and no explicit sandbox/test-mode environment, test API keys, or documented way to isolate test traffic from production data is mentioned anywhere in the evidence pack. While a developer could manually stand up a separate database, there is no first-party 'sandbox environment' feature, staging mode, or test-data isolation guidance cited. Missing for 10: documented sandbox/staging environment, test API keys or test mode, guidance on isolating test data from production.
